user_query: I am organizing a company conference and need to send out invitations to our clients. Before sending the emails, I want to verify the email addresses to ensure they are valid. Additionally, I would like to include the company's heartbeat status in the email.

TaskList.description: Gather the list of email addresses of clients.
Verify the validity of the email addresses collected.
Retrieve the current heartbeat status of the company.
Compose the invitation emails including the heartbeat status.
Send the invitation emails to clients.
